lines.2: 「Yo, Leo. What're you doing all by yourself? Your work done?」
lines.4: 「Nice reaction. You could make it as a comedian.」
lines.5: 「For some reason, hearing that from you is incredibly depressing.」
lines.7: 「Then let's head home. We're done with executive-committee work too.」
lines.11: 「But... the magazine said wearing this would make me irresistible...」
lines.12: 「It also said results may vary by individual.」
lines.13: 「Even so, if there's even the slightest chance it'll make me more popular... How could I NOT buy it!?」
lines.14: 「That's manly in a whole different way, Fukahire.」
lines.16: 「Because the kid made up with that girl he was fighting with.」
lines.17: 「Exactly! The panic when your friend gets a girlfriend! I wanted YOU to suffer that before I did!」
lines.19: For some reason, my heart jumped.
lines.21: 「Don't get rattled over something like that, small fry.」
lines.22: 「That's how it starts, and then it develops into something more!」
lines.23: 「What!? Is that how it is, punk!?」
lines.25: Wait. Why did I turn that into a question?
lines.26: 「If Konoe had a face like an Okame mask, my mental equilibrium would've survived.」
lines.28: I didn't even have the energy left to get angry.
lines.29: Huh. Talking to these guys had returned my mind to normal before I even noticed.
lines.30: I couldn't fit into a full-blown youth drama, but I fit in just fine here.
lines.31: 「Think volunteering would make me more popular?」
lines.32: Probably because everyone here was rotten in one way or another.
lines.33: 「Don't. Doing it with that motive isn't right.」
lines.34: 「Man, it's hot today. Muggy as hell.」
lines.35: 「Leo, I'll come over tonight and make hiyashi chuka.」
lines.36: 「Nice. I think Otome'll be happy too.」
lines.37: Well, rotten or not, they were good people.
